about.heading: Woodwork That Follows the Forest
about.para1: At Moutcha Bay Resort, our carpentry work focused on the outdoor connections around the forest cabins: timber walkways, steps, landings and wooden railings. The layout follows the cabins and the hillside, with decking fitted around the existing trees.
about.para2: The site photos follow the work from exposed timber framing and on-site cutting through to deck-board installation and railing assembly. Individual cuts around trunks, posts and cabin corners connect these separate details into one continuous timber route.

details.label: Setting
details.value: Forest cabins on a wooded hillside

scope.heading: The Carpentry Scope
scope.intro: The work brings together the supporting timber, walking surfaces and railing details around the cabins. Each part is fitted to the changes in level and the surrounding site.

cards.title: Timber Walkway Framing
cards.text: Supporting timber framing for the outdoor walkways and landings, shaped to follow the cabin edges and the hillside layout.

cards.title: Decking & Walking Surfaces
cards.text: Deck-board installation along the paths and cabin approaches, including the cuts needed around posts, corners and existing trees.

cards.title: Wooden Stairs & Landings
cards.text: Steps and timber landings connecting different levels along the outdoor routes beside the cabins.

cards.title: Railings & Wood Details
cards.text: Wooden posts, rails and vertical railing members fitted along the walkways and stair sections.

challenge.heading: Working With the Site
challenge.text: Cabin entrances, trees and changes in ground level all influence the route. The timber work has to follow these conditions rather than repeat a single straight layout.

approach.heading: Fitted on Site
approach.text: The framing, deck boards and railing sections were cut and assembled around the actual spaces between cabins and trees. The photos show these details taking shape throughout the work.

items.question: What work did VV Renovation carry out at Moutcha Bay?
items.answer: Our work shown here is the outdoor carpentry around the forest cabins: timber walkway framing, decking, steps, landings and wooden railings.

items.question: Where is Moutcha Bay Resort?
items.answer: Moutcha Bay Resort is on Vancouver Island, near Gold River, on the shores of Nootka Sound in British Columbia.

items.question: How does the woodwork fit around the trees?
items.answer: The decking and supporting frame follow the spaces between the cabins and existing trees. The site photos show individual cuts around trunks, changes in direction and the connections between steps, landings and walkways.

items.question: Can we discuss a similar carpentry project?
items.answer: Yes. Send photos, approximate dimensions and a description of the work through the form below. VV Renovation is based in Richmond and serves Greater Vancouver; work elsewhere can be discussed individually.
